narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating has $916M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Obligations are up 361.8% year over year and come from 2 awards, with an average award size of $458M. Annual obligations rose from $38.9M in FY21 to $916M in FY26, with intermediate totals of $42.9M in FY22, $50M in FY23, $85M in FY24, and $198M in FY25. The firm's FY2026 obligations concentrate in two NAICS markets: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing at $900M and Nuclear Electric Power Generation at $15.9M. The FY2026 totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals. Contract counts and award-size figures indicate a small number of large awards are driving the year-over-year increase. Contractors and agency acquisition planners can use these facts to assess how concentrated American Centrifuge Operating’s federal work is by market and by award size.
